title: DEMA Durable Internal Identity Mapping and Audit Metadata Foundation
scope: Internal SQLite storage contract only; no transport, server wiring, public route, session issuance, or runtime activation.

implementation.database_path_policy: The caller must supply the SQLite database path explicitly. No default live path is defined and no production database is created by this artifact.
implementation.transaction_boundary: Mapping mutation and its successful audit event commit atomically or roll back together.

identity_mappings.purpose: Durable internal mapping from one literal Telegram identity to one bounded user and tenant context.
invariants: Telegram identity is an ASCII digit string of length 1-20 and is preserved literally without normalization.
One internal user cannot span incompatible tenant, role, or status contexts.
platform_admin is outside the Telegram mapping boundary and is rejected.
Unknown or invalid identity resolution returns no mapping; policy remains deny-by-default.

audit_events.purpose: Bounded audit record for successful identity mapping mutations.

metadata_boundary.identity_fingerprint: Lowercase SHA-256 of the literal Telegram identity.

invariants: Audit rows contain a safe fingerprint, never the raw Telegram identity.
Audit metadata is JSON-compatible, bounded, and validated before commit.
A failed audit append rolls back the corresponding mapping mutation.

retention_boundary.mapping_records: No production retention, deletion, or export policy is enabled by this internal foundation.
retention_boundary.audit_events: No production retention or erasure schedule is enabled; a reviewed policy is required before any live use.
retention_boundary.operational_boundary: Tests and operations must supply an isolated database path and must not populate this artifact with real identities.

security_invariants: The module does not modify server.py, plugin_api.py, roster, phase1 readiness, owner auth, runtime ACL, scheduler, cron, provider configuration, or public routes.
This catalog contains no real identity, secret, credential, bearer value, or absolute filesystem path.
platform_admin remains in the separate owner/admin boundary and cannot be granted through Telegram mapping.
